faq_heading: Eastern Hillsides houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Eastern Hillsides sell for?
faq.a: 56 houses sold in Eastern Hillsides between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,142,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Eastern Hillsides?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Eastern Hillsides sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 56 houses that sold in Eastern Hillsides went for between $1,050,000 and $1,302,500, around a median of $1,142,500.

faq.q: Do houses in Eastern Hillsides sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 56 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.5% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Eastern Hillsides?
faq.a: The median year built was 2017 for the 56 houses sold in Eastern Hillsides.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Eastern Hillsides usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Eastern Hillsides had 5 bedrooms, from the 56 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Eastern Hillsides houses for sale now
What Eastern Hillsides houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

56 houses sold in Eastern Hillsides with a median price of $1,142,500 (the middle half sold between $1,050,000 and $1,302,500), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $350 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median lot of 7,253 square feet.

blocks.text: How Eastern Hillsides compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median house in Eastern Hillsides sold for $1,142,500, 38% above the Chilliwack median of $825,000 across 294 sales. Eastern Hillsides houses took a median 24 days to sell, against 26 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
